description: This Java class 'ParameterListTable' extends JTable and manages the display of parameter data in a table, including custom cell rendering and editing, as well as tooltips. It is used in the context of ECU parameter list visualization within the RomRaider application.

classes.name: ParameterListTable
classes.description: A custom JTable for displaying and editing ECU parameter lists with support for specialized cell rendering and sorting behaviors.

methods.name: ParameterListTable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the table with a specific data model, disables column reordering, and sets column sortability based on column names.

methods.name: getCellRenderer
methods.description: Returns a custom cell renderer, using a combo box renderer for certain EcuData and ExternalData objects.

methods.name: getCellEditor
methods.description: Returns a custom cell editor, using a combo box editor for certain EcuData and ExternalData objects.

methods.name: getToolTipText
methods.description: Provides tooltip text for table rows, displaying parameter descriptions when available.

methods.name: displayComboBox
methods.description: Determines whether a cell should display a combo box based on its data type and available converters.

methods.name: setColumnSortable
methods.description: Enables or disables sorting for a specific column.
